context.role: long-press action sheet entry that opens the tag sheet
context.tone: Sentence-ish label, the ellipsis is U+2026 and means a sheet opens.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered only when capabilities.session_tags.available is true; the row itself never carries tag controls.
Owned relay SPA session copy. The conversation's name is deliberately not repeated here: the action sheet that opened this one already named it.

context.tone: lowercase; no advice, the hint below carries it.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shown only when the catalogue resolved and has no entries; the phone cannot create categories.

en: create one in the desktop app or the terminal
ur: ڈیسک ٹاپ ایپ یا ٹرمینل میں ایک بنائیں

context.role: empty-catalogue hint naming the surfaces that own category identity
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Category create/rename deliberately lives in the desktop app and agent callers, not the phone.

en: Could not load the tag catalogue.
ur: ٹیگ کیٹلاگ لوڈ نہیں ہو سکا۔

context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Paired with the retry control; the daemon's own refusal is not shown here because the read carries none.

context.role: re-read the catalogue after a failure

en: {count} tags is the most a conversation can carry — remove one to add another.
ur: {count} ٹیگز ایک گفتگو کے لیے زیادہ سے زیادہ حد ہے — دوسرا شامل کرنے کے لیے ایک ہٹائیں۔

context.role: explains why unchecked categories are disabled at the cap
context.tone: Sentence, em dash, {count} is the relay's cap.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Also the aria-describedby target of every disabled row, so the reason is audible, not only visible.

context.role: screen-reader word beside the row's leading dot
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The primary mark is a shape plus this word, never colour alone.

context.role: accessible name of a selected row's primary radio
context.tone: lowercase, {name} is the category's own name.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The radio itself is mark-only; this sentence is what a screen reader hears.

en: {count, plural, one {# more tag} other {# more tags}}
ur: {count, plural, one {# مزید ٹیگ} other {# مزید ٹیگز}}

context.role: accessible name of the row's +N mark
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. The visible mark is only +N, so this is the whole sentence assistive tech gets.

context.role: note beside an assigned category absent from the registry
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Such a row stays selectable so the reader can remove an assignment the catalogue can no longer explain.

context.role: per-row pending mark while an assignment write is in flight
refusal lead for a rejected assignment write
context.tone: Sentence case, no terminal punctuation: the daemon's own sentence follows after a colon.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Shared refusal hygiene (lib/refusal) appends the relay's sentence, which is written for this reader and passes through unrewritten.

context.role: first press of the two-step clear
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Turns into the confirm pair; no write happens on this press.

context.role: the confirmation press that clears the assignment
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Sends the exact empty desired state {tags: [], primary: null}.

context.role: inline confirm's cancel button in the remove-all row
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Cancels the pending remove-all confirmation and writes nothing.
Owned relay SPA session copy. Closes the sheet; every assignment already landed as its own write.

en: touch and hold a row to pin or tag it
ur: پن یا ٹیگ کرنے کے لیے قطار کو دبا کر رکھیں

context.role: long-press discoverer when the relay also serves tags
context.tone: Preserve current copy and casing, lowercase. Names both verbs a long-press offers.
context.note: Owned relay SPA session copy. Rendered only when capabilities.session_tags.available is true; relays without the tag routes keep the pin-only sentence, so the hint never promises a screen this build cannot serve.
